pages.text: $(bold)Artillery Configuration Tool$()$(br2)$(o)Creative mode only$() - A debug tool for fine-tuning cannon parameters.$(br2)$(bold)Adjustable Parameters:$()$(br)• Damage and explosion power$(br)• Reload time and firing cooldown$(br)• Projectile velocity and drag$(br)• Dispersion angle$(br)• Fuse delay and penetration

$(bold)Usage:$()$(br)1. Obtain from creative menu$(br)2. Right-click to open configuration GUI$(br)3. Adjust sliders and values$(br)4. Click 'Apply' to save changes$(br)5. Export/Import CSV for batch editing$(br2)$(bold)Note:$() This tool is for modpack developers and testing. Changes persist in world data.
